```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use App\Models\Url;

class UrlController extends Controller
{
    public function index()
    {
        return response()->json(Url::all());
    }

    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $url = new Url();
        $url->url = $request->input('url');
        if ($url->save()) {
            return response()->json($url, 201);
        } else {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Failed to store URL'], 400);
        }
    }

    public function show($id)
    {
        $url = Url::find($id);
        if ($url) {
            return response()->json($url);
        } else {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'URL not found'], 404);
        }
    }

    public function update(Request $request, $id)
    {
        $url = Url::find($id);
        if ($url) {
            $url->url = $request->input('url');
            if ($url->save()) {
                return response()->json($url);
            } else {
                return response()->json(['error' => 'Failed to update URL'], 400);
            }
        } else {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'URL not found'], 404);
        }
    }

    public function destroy($id)
    {
        $url = Url::find($id);
        if ($url) {
            if ($url->delete()) {
                return response()->json(['message' => 'URL deleted successfully']);
            } else {
                return response()->json(['error' => 'Failed to delete URL'], 400);
            }
        } else {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'URL not found'], 404);
        }
    }
}
```
